name: Complete Magnesium Care
subtitle: For restful sleep, reduced stress & faster muscle recovery
description: Body tired, mind restless - yet sleep won't come? We have got you covered with the ultimate Magnesium Kit for deep sleep, stress relief, and muscle recovery! 🌿 Fact: Nearly 60% of women are Magnesium deficient, impacting sleep, stress levels, and muscle health. ▶️ Chronic stress depletes Magnesium, leading to fatigue, anxiety, and restless sleep. ▶️ Low Magnesium levels contribute to muscle cramps, headaches, and poor recovery. Our carefully curated Magnesium kit restores balance and relaxation for your body and mind: 1️⃣ 10% Magnesium Lotion 300ml – Fast-absorbing topical solution to relax muscles, and ease tension via transdermal absorption 2️⃣ Magnesium Gummies 60N – Formulated with 5 forms of Magnesium to improve sleep quality, and reduce stress. ✅ Fortified with Vitamin B6, D3 & B9 ✅ Non-habit forming ✅ No added refined sugar Your daily dose of relaxation and well-being! ✨"
usage: Magnesium Gummies: Take one gummy post meal, 1-2 hours before bed. Magnesium Lotion: Step 1: Take 3-4 pumps of the product in your palms. Step 2: Disperse product across feet, soles, legs, arms, neck, shoulder and massage it in for a few seconds for full absorption. Use post a heavy workout or before bed.

list.title: How to use the kit?
list.content:
Magnesium Gummies:
Take one gummy post meal, 1-2 hours before bed.
Magnesium Lotion:
Disperse product across feet, soles, legs, arms, neck, shoulder and massage it in for a few seconds for full absorption. Use it post heavy workout or before going to bed.

list.title: Caution
list.content:
To see a noticeable difference in you, it is recommended that you use these Magnesium Gummies regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. We suggest taking a doctor's consultation before incorporating it in your routine. These gummies won't cause any reactions, if it does, please stop using them and consult a doctor before adding them back to your routine.

list.title: If there is no refined sugar, how is it sweet?
list.content: The sweetness comes from prebiotic fibre called chicory root. It also has very low (near zero) glycemic index & causes no glucose spikes. Chicory also is good for gut.

list.title: Are there any artificial additives?
list.content: No. The base of this gummy is made of a prebiotic fibre called chicory root. The colour comes from black carrot extract & the flavour comes from mixed berry extract. There are no artificial fillers, preservatives added.

list.title: Can I use this Gummy every day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using these gummies every day.

list.title: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
list.content: These gummies are generally safe for everyone to consume. But if you have a critical health condition, or if you are pregnant, then we recommend speaking to a healthcare professional.

list.title: Can Magnesium help with anxiety and stress?
list.content: Yes, Magnesium is an essential micronutrient, getting enough of which helps reduce stress and anxiety by balancing neurotransmitter levels and lowering stress hormones. Additionally, it also helps with muscle cramps/pain relief & aids in 300+ biochemical reactions in the body.

list.title: Can I take Magnesium gummies along with other supplements, like Biotin?
list.content: Yes, you can. Magnesium also supports the function of other vitamins and minerals.

list.title: Are there any allergens in the product?
list.content: Check the specific product label for allergen information, but most Magnesium Glycinate products are formulated to be free from common allergens like natural gluten, dairy, or soy.

list.title: Do I need to take a blood test before taking Magnesium?
list.content: No, a blood test is generally unnecessary for adults who wish to take magnesium supplements at recommended doses unless symptoms or certain medical conditions suggest an imbalance.
